title: An Asymptotic One-Sample Surrogate for Non-Gaussian ERM with General Convex Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27754v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study convex empirical risk minimization (ERM) with non-Gaussian features and nonsmooth penalties through a surrogate driven by a single Gaussian vector. The surrogate preserves the penalty and calibrates its coefficients using the actual joint law of the feature-label model. We prove that this population calibration exists and is unique. We prove a Gaussian approximation for fresh prediction scores when the data satisfy a Poincar\'e inequality.   Together with regularity conditions on the losses, this approximation yields agreement between the ERM minimizer and its surrogate in normalized means and prediction variances, as well as formulas for prediction and classification risks. The result covers general uniformly strongly convex penalties and pure Lasso under projection anti-concentration. translated_title: 具有一般凸正则化的非高斯经验风险最小化的渐近单样本代理模型
translated_abstract: 我们通过由单个高斯向量驱动的代理模型来研究具有非高斯特征和非光滑惩罚项的凸经验风险最小化（ERM）。该代理模型保留了原始惩罚项，并利用特征-标签模型的实际联合分布来校准其系数。我们证明了这种总体校准的存在性和唯一性。当数据满足庞加莱（Poincaré）不等式时，我们证明了对新样本预测分数的高斯近似。结合损失函数的正则性条件，该近似使得ERM最小化器与其代理模型在归一化均值和预测方差上达成一致，并给出了预测风险和分类风险的公式。该结果涵盖了一致强凸惩罚项的一般情形，以及在投影反集中条件下的纯Lasso。核心证明依赖于腔方法的哈密顿-雅可比（Hamilton-Jacobi）论证，可在无需求导的情况下比较两个最小化器的主要统计量。
tldr: 该论文提出一种由单个高斯向量驱动的代理模型来近似非高斯特征下的凸经验风险最小化（ERM），证明该代理与原ERM最小化器在归一化均值和预测方差上渐近一致，并给出适用于一般一致强凸正则化及纯Lasso的预测与分类风险显式公式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a single-Gaussian-vector-driven surrogate for convex ERM with non-Gaussian features, proving asymptotic agreement with the original ERM minimizer in normalized means and prediction variances, and providing explicit prediction and classification risk formulas covering general uniformly strongly convex regularizers and pure Lasso.
